# IQWealth — iraqsm.com

> Live prices, interactive charts, indices, and bilingual (Arabic/English) company profiles for every stock on the Iraq Stock Exchange (ISX). Tracks the RSISX index, market movers, trading volumes, and per-company history. اسعار الاسهم العراقية مباشرة، سوق الاسهم العراقي، بورصة العراق.

Iraqsm.com is a free Iraq Stock Exchange (ISX) market tracker. Prices and OHLC data originate from the ISX portal and Rabee Securities (RSISX); long-range historical closes are corporate-action adjusted (dividends, capital increases). Currency is the Iraqi Dinar (IQD). Content is available in Arabic (default) and English.

Prices update once per trading session, from the official ISX daily bulletin — there is no intraday feed. Roughly a fifth of listed companies have not traded in over 60 days; the site marks those as suspended, shows the date of their last actual trade, and does not report a market cap for them, since market cap is last price x shares and that price can be years old.

## Main pages

- [Home — market overview](https://iraqsm.com): RSISX index, gainers/losers, and the full list of ISX-listed companies with live prices.
- [Market](https://iraqsm.com/market): Full searchable/sortable table of all ISX stocks by sector, price, change, and volume. Accepts a query via `?q=` (e.g. /market?q=TASC). Splits trading companies from suspended ones (no trade in 60+ days).
- [Screener](https://iraqsm.com/screener): Filter and rank ISX stocks by performance (day/week/month/year), liquidity, P/E, foreign flow, and distance from the 52-week high.
- [Companies](https://iraqsm.com/companies): Directory of all 104 listed companies grouped by sector, each linking to its price page.
- [Statistics](https://iraqsm.com/statistics): Foreign investor buy/sell flow by company and sector, ownership split between Iraqi and foreign holders, and major shareholders.
- [Heatmap](https://iraqsm.com/heatmap): Treemap of the whole market — tile size is market cap, colour is performance, grouped by sector.
- [Pulse](https://iraqsm.com/pulse): Market breadth — advancers vs decliners, up/down volume, new highs/lows, advance-decline line.
- [Charts](https://iraqsm.com/charts): Interactive index and stock charts (1W to 5Y and since-2015), with RSI and moving averages. There is no intraday view: ISX publishes one bulletin per trading session.
- [Banks](https://iraqsm.com/banks): The ISX banking sector — the largest group of listed companies.
- [Currency (IQD/USD)](https://iraqsm.com/fx): Iraqi Dinar to US Dollar rates and converter.
- [Gold](https://iraqsm.com/gold): Gold prices in Iraq — per gram and mithqal, 24K/21K/18K.
- [Oil](https://iraqsm.com/oil): Oil prices — Brent, WTI, Basrah Heavy/Medium, OPEC basket — in USD and IQD per barrel.
- [News](https://iraqsm.com/news): Iraqi economy and market news.
- [Research](https://iraqsm.com/research): Market research and analysis.
- [Learn](https://iraqsm.com/learn): Educational guides on investing in the Iraq Stock Exchange.
- [About](https://iraqsm.com/about): About iraqsm.com.

## Company pages

Each listed company has its own page at `https://iraqsm.com/c/{TICKER}` with a live price, OHLC candlestick chart (multiple timeframes), trading volume, market cap, and a bilingual company profile. Examples:

- [TASC — Asiacell Communications (Telecom)](https://iraqsm.com/c/TASC)
- [TZNI — Al-Khatem Telecommunication / Zain Iraq · زين العراق (Telecom)](https://iraqsm.com/c/TZNI)
- [BBOB — Bank of Baghdad](https://iraqsm.com/c/BBOB)
- [BMNS — Al-Mansour Bank](https://iraqsm.com/c/BMNS)
- [IBSD — Baghdad Soft Drinks (Industry)](https://iraqsm.com/c/IBSD)
- [BNOI — National Bank of Iraq](https://iraqsm.com/c/BNOI)

The complete ticker list (104 companies across Banks, Industry, Services, Hotels & Tourism, Telecom, Agriculture, Insurance, and Investment sectors) is in:

## Optional

- [Full company index (llms-full.txt)](https://iraqsm.com/llms-full.txt): Every ISX ticker with its name, sector, and page URL.
